name: Ahimaaz
bio: Ahimaaz was the son of the priest Zadok. When David fled Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion and sent Zadok and Abiathar back into the city with the ark, he arranged for Ahimaaz and Abiathar's son Jonathan to stay behind with their fathers as runners, ready to carry word to David of anything David's spy Hushai learned inside Absalom's camp (2 Samuel 15:27-28, 36). Ahimaaz's role carrying crucial, dangerous messages between Jerusalem and David is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
